  // ====== bld45 (2.11 · C4 ו-D4): התעשייה, הלוגיסטיקה, תחנת הכיבוי 2, ארגז הכלים ודלק טורבו 2 ======
  // the brand plate in the brand's own colours (brandSign is the market's green one): the logo at the right, the name in Hebrew
  function brandPlate(c, F, cx, z, name, key, o) {
    o = o || {}; var y = Y(F, z), fs = o.fs || 9, h = fs * 1.6, col = LOGO_COL[key] || ['#2f363c', '#ffffff'];
    c.font = '800 ' + fs + 'px ' + SANS; var tw = c.measureText(name).width, lw = h * .92, w = tw + lw + fs * 1.2, x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = y - h / 2;
    if (F.night) R(c, rg(c, cx, y, w * .8, ['rgba(255,236,190,.32)', 'rgba(255,236,190,0)']), cx - w, y - h * 2, w * 2, h * 4);
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)', x0 + 1, y0 + 1.4, w, h);
    RR(c, x0, y0, w, h, 2, F.night ? sh(col[0], .12) : col[0]); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)', x0 + 1, y0 + .8, w - 2, h * .3);
    R(c, col[1], x0 + 2, y0 + h - 2.2, w - 4, 1.2);
    c.fillStyle = col[1]; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle'; c.direction = 'rtl'; c.fillText(name, x0 + fs * .5 + tw / 2, y0 + h * .5);
    var lx = x0 + w - lw - fs * .25, ly = y0 + (h - lw) / 2;
    if (LOGO[key]) c.drawImage(LOGO[key], lx, ly, lw, lw); else { E(c, lx + lw / 2, ly + lw / 2, lw / 2, lw / 2, col[1]); }
  }
  // the dock door of a warehouse: the black seal, the sectional door (its bottom at the platform, 1.2 m), the two bumpers, the yellow edge, the dock light
  function dockDoor(c, F, x, w, open, N) {
    var z0 = 1.2, zt = 4.0, y0 = Y(F, zt + .25), y1 = Y(F, 0);
    R(c, N ? '#0e1114' : '#1d2125', x - 2.2, y0, w + 4.4, Y(F, z0 - .1) - y0);                                 // the seal around the door
    if (open) { R(c, N ? '#2a2318' : '#3a342b', x, Y(F, zt), w, (zt - z0) * M * K); R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,214,140,.5)' : 'rgba(255,214,140,.18)', x + 2, Y(F, zt - .4), w - 4, (zt - z0 - .6) * M * K); }   // open: the lit inside
    else { R(c, N ? '#4c545c' : '#c4c9cc', x, Y(F, zt), w, (zt - z0) * M * K); for (var k = 1; k < 7; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.14)', x, Y(F, zt) + k * (zt - z0) * M * K / 7, w, .4); }
    R(c, '#2a2d30', x + 2, Y(F, z0 - .1), 3, .5 * M * K); R(c, '#2a2d30', x + w - 5, Y(F, z0 - .1), 3, .5 * M * K);      // the rubber bumpers
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { R(c, i % 2 ? '#1d1f22' : '#f2c230', x - 2.2, Y(F, z0) + i * 1.1, 1.4, 1.1); R(c, i % 2 ? '#1d1f22' : '#f2c230', x + w + .8, Y(F, z0) + i * 1.1, 1.4, 1.1); }
    R(c, '#6b7176', x - .5, Y(F, z0), w + 1, .8);                                                                   // the leveler's lip
    R(c, N ? '#ffe9a8' : '#9aa1a6', x + w / 2 - 1.5, Y(F, zt + .6), 3, 1.2);                                      // the dock light
  }
  function hazardStripe(c, F, x0, x1, z) { for (var x = x0; x < x1; x += 4) R(c, ((x - x0) / 4) % 2 < 1 ? '#f2c230' : '#2a2d30', x, Y(F, z + .35), 4, .35 * M * K); }
  function whType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, H = o.H || 8;
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'work', W: W, D: D, floors: 1, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: o.roofCol || '#c3c8cb', rim: '#e6e9ea', parapet: .4 });
        var y0 = Rc[1] - h * M * K, d = Rc[3] - Rc[1];
        for (var x = Rc[0] + 16; x < Rc[2] - 14; x += 34) { R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,230,170,.18)' : 'rgba(176,206,222,.75)', x, y0 + 7, 7, d - 14); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', x + 7, y0 + 7, 1, d - 14); }   // the skylight strips
        if (W > 25) { hvac(c, Rc[2] - 34, Rc[1] + 10, h, 18, 10, N); hvac(c, Rc[0] + 22, Rc[3] - 22, h, 14, 9, N); } },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night;
        MAT.metal(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, side === 'S' ? (o.wall || '#d8dde0') : mix(o.wall || '#d8dde0', '#8f979c', .14));
        R(c, N ? '#545b62' : '#a7adb1', x0, Y(F, 1.0), Wx, 1.0 * M * K);                                           // the concrete plinth
        band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .9, .6, o.accent || '#2f5f9e');
        if (side !== 'S') { for (var x = x0 + 10; x < x1 - 18; x += 26) win(c, F, x, 14, F.h - 2.6, 1.0, { noShutter: true, panes: 3, frame: '#59636b', seed: 21 });
          if (o.sign && Wx > 70) textSign(c, x0 + Wx * .5, Y(F, F.h - 1.9), o.sign, 5.5, o.signBg || '#2f5f9e', '#ffffff', N); return; }   // the name on the side the camera sees too
        var n = o.docks || 0, dw = o.dw || 30, pitch = o.pitch || 55, span = n * dw + (n - 1) * (pitch - dw), sx = o.dockFrom != null ? x0 + o.dockFrom : x0 + (Wx - span) / 2;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) dockDoor(c, F, sx + i * pitch, dw, (o.open || []).indexOf(i) >= 0, N);
        if (o.roller) { var rx = o.roller < 0 ? x1 + o.roller : x0 + o.roller; R(c, N ? '#1d232a' : '#4a4f55', rx - 1, Y(F, 4.6), 42, 4.6 * M * K); R(c, N ? '#4b545e' : '#bfc5c9', rx, Y(F, 4.5), 40, 4.5 * M * K);
          for (var k = 1; k < 10; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', rx, Y(F, 4.5) + k * 4.5 * M * K / 10, 40, .35); hazardStripe(c, F, rx - 1, rx + 41, 0); }
        var px = o.pdoor != null ? (o.pdoor < 0 ? x1 + o.pdoor : x0 + o.pdoor) : x1 - 18;
        door(c, F, px, 10, 2.1, { frame: '#3d464d', solid: o.pdoorSolid ? '#6f7f8c' : null }); canopy(c, F, px - 3, 15, 2.8, .9, '#3d464d', {});
        if (o.office) { var ox = px < x0 + Wx / 2 ? px + 14 : px - 46; win(c, F, ox, 34, 1.2, 2.2, { noShutter: true, panes: 4, frame: '#2f363c', seed: 5, lit: N ? true : null }); win(c, F, ox, 34, 4.4, 2.2, { noShutter: true, panes: 4, frame: '#2f363c', seed: 6, lit: N ? true : null }); }
        if (o.key) brandPlate(c, F, x0 + Wx * (o.signAt || .5), F.h - 1.9, o.sign, o.key, { fs: o.fs || 8 });
        else if (o.sign) textSign(c, x0 + Wx * (o.signAt || .5), Y(F, F.h - 1.9), o.sign, o.fs || 6.5, o.signBg || '#2f5f9e', '#ffffff', N); },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { }
    };
  }
  // a metalworks hall: the sawtooth roof (the glass faces north), brick-coloured walls with pilasters, the big roller door, the stack
  function factoryType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, H = o.H || 8.5;
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'work', W: W, D: D, floors: 1, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: '#b9b3a8', rim: '#ddd6c9', parapet: .3 });
        var y0 = Rc[1] - h * M * K, d = Rc[3] - Rc[1], tooth = 26;
        for (var y = y0 + 4; y < y0 + d - tooth * .6; y += tooth) {                                                    // the teeth run east–west; each: a sloped sheet and a glass strip
          R(c, N ? '#3d4248' : lg(c, 0, y, 0, y + tooth, ['#d8d2c6', '#b7b0a3']), Rc[0] + 3, y, Rc[2] - Rc[0] - 6, tooth - 6);
          R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,226,160,.35)' : '#7fa3b8', Rc[0] + 3, y + tooth - 6, Rc[2] - Rc[0] - 6, 5); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.18)', Rc[0] + 3, y + tooth - 1, Rc[2] - Rc[0] - 6, 1); }
        var sx = Rc[2] - 26, sy = Rc[1] + 18, top = y0 + 18 - (h + 5) * M * K * .0;                                      // the stack: a tall round chimney at the north-east
        R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)', sx + 3, sy - h * M * K + 2, 6, 6); R(c, N ? '#5b6168' : '#8c8f91', sx, sy - (h + 6) * M * K, 6, 6 * M * K); E(c, sx + 3, sy - (h + 6) * M * K, 3, 1.5, N ? '#2a2e33' : '#3b3f43'); R(c, '#b5352b', sx, sy - (h + 5) * M * K, 6, 1.2); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night, col = side === 'S' ? '#c98f6b' : '#b98263';
        MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col);
        for (var x = x0; x < x1; x += 40) R(c, N ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)' : 'rgba(90,50,30,.22)', x, Y(F, F.h), 3, F.h * M * K);         // the pilasters
        band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .6, .6, '#8a5a40');
        for (var x2 = x0 + 12; x2 < x1 - 20; x2 += 40) win(c, F, x2, 22, F.h - 3.4, 2.0, { noShutter: true, panes: 4, frame: '#3d4246', seed: 17, lit: N ? true : null });
        if (side !== 'S') return;
        var rx = x0 + Wx * .2; R(c, N ? '#1d232a' : '#3f4448', rx - 1.5, Y(F, 5.3), 53, 5.3 * M * K); R(c, N ? '#4b545e' : '#9aa3a8', rx, Y(F, 5.2), 50, 5.2 * M * K);
        for (var k = 1; k < 12; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', rx, Y(F, 5.2) + k * 5.2 * M * K / 12, 50, .35); hazardStripe(c, F, rx - 1.5, rx + 51.5, 0);
        door(c, F, x0 + Wx * .62, 10, 2.1, { frame: '#3d464d' }); canopy(c, F, x0 + Wx * .62 - 3, 16, 2.8, .9, '#3d464d', {});
        textSign(c, x0 + Wx * .7, Y(F, F.h - 1.8), o.sign || 'מטרו עבודות מתכת', 6.5, '#3b3f43', '#f2c230', N); },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { }
    };
  }
  // an office of two or three floors: ribbon windows on every floor, the glass entrance under a canopy, the roof units
  function officeType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, n = o.floors || 2, fh = 3.3, H = n * fh + .6;
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'work', W: W, D: D, floors: n, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: '#cfd1ce', rim: '#f2f0ea', parapet: .6 }); hvac(c, Rc[0] + 18, Rc[1] + 12, h, 16, 10, N); hvac(c, Rc[2] - 40, Rc[1] + 14, h, 16, 10, N); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night;
        MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, side === 'S' ? (o.wall || '#eef0ee') : mix(o.wall || '#eef0ee', '#a9afb2', .12));
        for (var f = 0; f < n; f++) { R(c, N ? '#2a333d' : '#3b4650', x0 + 4, Y(F, f * fh + 2.9), Wx - 8, .25 * M * K);
          win(c, F, x0 + 6, Wx - 12, f * fh + .9, 1.9, { noShutter: true, panes: Math.max(3, Math.round(Wx / 14)), frame: '#2f363c', seed: 30 + f, lit: N ? (f + side.length) % 2 === 0 : null }); }
        band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .4, .4, o.accent || '#1f4f7a');
        if (side !== 'S') return;
        var dx = x0 + Wx * (o.doorAt || .5) - 8; R(c, N ? '#e9eef2' : '#f4f6f7', dx - 3, Y(F, 3.2), 22, 3.2 * M * K); door(c, F, dx - 2, 20, 2.1, { leaves: 2, frame: '#2f363c' }); canopy(c, F, dx - 6, 28, 3.0, 1.4, o.accent || '#1f4f7a', {});
        textSign(c, x0 + Wx * .5, Y(F, F.h - 1.0), o.sign || 'משרדים', 6, o.accent || '#1f4f7a', '#ffffff', N); },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0) return; if (!ph) { paving(c, 0, foot[1], foot[0], 16, N, '#d9d6cf'); return; } plantPot(c, 10, foot[1] + 8, .5); plantPot(c, foot[0] - 12, foot[1] + 8, .5); }
    };
  }
  // the gatehouse: a small glass booth, a roof that overhangs on all sides
  function boothType(o) {
    var W = o.W || 4.2, D = o.D || 3, H = o.H || 3.1;
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'work', W: W, D: D, floors: 1, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { var y0 = Rc[1] - h * M * K, ov = 4; R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)', Rc[0] - ov + 3, y0 - ov + 4, Rc[2] - Rc[0] + 2 * ov, Rc[3] - Rc[1] + 2 * ov);
        R(c, N ? '#3a4048' : '#e9ecee', Rc[0] - ov, y0 - ov, Rc[2] - Rc[0] + 2 * ov, Rc[3] - Rc[1] + 2 * ov); R(c, '#f2c230', Rc[0] - ov, y0 + Rc[3] - Rc[1] + ov - 2, Rc[2] - Rc[0] + 2 * ov, 2); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night;
        MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, '#f1f1ee'); win(c, F, x0 + 3, Wx - 6, 1.0, 1.6, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#2f363c', seed: 41, lit: N ? true : null });
        if (side === 'S') textSign(c, x0 + Wx * .5, Y(F, F.h - .25), o.sign || 'השער', 4, '#2f5f9e', '#ffffff', N); else door(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 - 5, 10, 2.1, { frame: '#2f363c' }); },   /* p493: דלת להולכי רגל */
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { }
    };
  }
  // a big shop: the glass front, the double door under a canopy, the brand plate in the brand's colours (the chosen logo)
  function shopType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, H = o.H || 6.5;
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'shop', W: W, D: D, floors: 1, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: '#cfccc4', rim: '#f2eee6', parapet: .8 }); if (W > 15) { hvac(c, Rc[0] + 20, Rc[1] + 14, h, 18, 10, N); skylight(c, Rc[0] + (Rc[2] - Rc[0]) * .55, Rc[1] + 12, h, 30, 16, N); } },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night, col = LOGO_COL[o.key] || ['#2f363c', '#ffffff'];
        MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, side === 'S' ? (o.wall || '#ece8de') : mix(o.wall || '#ece8de', '#a59f92', .12));
        band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .9, .9, col[1]);                                                                   // the fascia in the brand's colour
        if (side !== 'S') { if (Wx > 60) for (var x = x0 + 14; x < x1 - 30; x += 46) win(c, F, x, 20, 2.2, 1.6, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#4f585f', seed: 50 });
          if (Wx > 50) brandPlate(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5, F.h - 2.0, o.name, o.key, { fs: o.small ? 5.5 : 8 }); return; }   // a big shop carries its name on every side
        var gw = Wx * (o.small ? .55 : .62); win(c, F, x0 + 6, gw, .25, F.h - 2.0, { noShutter: true, panes: Math.max(3, Math.round(gw / 13)), frame: '#2f363c', seed: 52, lit: N ? true : null });
        var dx = x0 + 6 + gw + 6; door(c, F, dx, o.small ? 10 : 20, 2.1, { frame: '#2f363c' }); canopy(c, F, dx - 4, (o.small ? 12 : 18) + 8, 3.0, 1.3, col[0], {});
        if (!o.small) { R(c, N ? '#2f3a44' : '#f2f2ef', x1 - 26, Y(F, 2.2), 18, 2.2 * M * K); textSign(c, x1 - 17, Y(F, 1.6), 'כניסה לסחורה', 2.6, null, '#3b4248', N); }
        brandPlate(c, F, x0 + Wx * (o.signAt || .42), F.h - 2.0 + (o.small ? .4 : 0), o.name, o.key, { fs: o.fs || (o.small ? 6.5 : 9.5) }); },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0) return; if (!ph) { paving(c, 0, foot[1], foot[0], 14, N, '#d4cfc4'); return; } plantPot(c, 8, foot[1] + 8, .5); }
    };
  }
  function sideName(T, t, bg) { var w0 = T.wall; T.wall = function (c, F, m, side) { w0.call(this, c, F, m, side); if (side !== 'S' && F.x1 - F.x0 > 70) textSign(c, (F.x0 + F.x1) / 2, Y(F, F.h - 1.6), t, 6, bg, '#ffffff', F.night); }; return T; }

  /* ---------------- the model, the drawing order, the picture ---------------- */
  function rotRect(r, W, D, m) { var x = m.x, y = m.y, w = m.w, d = m.d, Q;
    if (r === 0) Q = [x, y, w, d]; else if (r === 2) Q = [W - x - w, D - y - d, w, d]; else if (r === 1) Q = [D - y - d, x, d, w]; else Q = [y, W - x - w, d, w];
    return [Q[0] * M, Q[1] * M, (Q[0] + Q[2]) * M, (Q[1] + Q[3]) * M]; }
  var SIDE = ['S', 'E', 'N', 'W'];   // the mass's own side that faces the world's south, for rot 0..3
  function model(id, rot) { var T = TYPES[id]; if (!T) throw new Error('BLD40: unknown type ' + id);
    var ms = T.masses().map(function (m, i) { return Object.assign({ i: i, R: rotRect(rot, T.W, T.D, m) }, m); });
    var fw = rot & 1 ? T.D : T.W, fd = rot & 1 ? T.W : T.D, H = Math.max.apply(null, ms.map(function (m) { return m.h + (m.ridge || 0); }));
    var q = T.q || API.Q, yS = fd * M; ms.forEach(function (m) { m.R = [m.R[0], yS - q * (yS - m.R[1]), m.R[2], yS - q * (yS - m.R[3])]; }); QY = q;   /* bld41: the roof depth × Q */
    return { T: T, rot: rot, ms: ms, foot: [fw * M, fd * M], H: H }; }
  function render(c, Mo, N) {
    var T = Mo.T, rot = Mo.rot, side = SIDE[rot];
    if (T.ground) T.ground(c, Mo.foot, rot, N, 0);
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = N ? 'rgba(4,8,14,.25)' : 'rgba(14,20,28,.30)'; c.beginPath();                // the cast shadows of every mass, one pass
    Mo.ms.forEach(function (m) { if (!m.roofRoom) shadowBox(c, m.R[0], m.R[1], m.R[2], m.R[3], m.h + (m.ridge || 0) * .6, 0); }); c.fill('nonzero'); c.restore();
    var host = Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return m.main; })[0] || Mo.ms[0];
    Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return !m.roofRoom; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.R[3] - b.R[3] || a.h - b.h; }).forEach(function (m) {
      var Rc = m.R, F = { x0: Rc[0], x1: Rc[2], yb: Rc[3], h: m.h, seed: m.i * 7 + rot + 1, night: N };
      if (m.tile) { T.wall(c, F, m, side); T.roof(c, Rc, m.h, m, N); } else { T.roof(c, Rc, m.h, m, N); T.wall(c, F, m, side); }
      R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)', Rc[0], F.yb - .8, Rc[2] - Rc[0], .8);
    });
    Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return m.roofRoom; }).forEach(function (m) { var Rc = m.R; T.roofRoom(c, Rc[0], Rc[1], Rc[2] - Rc[0], Rc[3] - Rc[1], host.h, m.h - host.h, N); });
    if (T.ground) T.ground(c, Mo.foot, rot, N, 1);
  }
  function extents(Mo) { var x0 = -8, y0 = 0, x1 = Mo.foot[0] + 8, y1 = Mo.foot[1] + 40;
    Mo.ms.forEach(function (m) { var Rc = m.R, hz = (m.h + (m.ridge || 0) + 3) * M; y0 = Math.min(y0, Rc[1] - hz * K - 18); x1 = Math.max(x1, Rc[2] + SX * m.h * M + 6); y1 = Math.max(y1, Rc[3] + SY * m.h * M + 6); });
    return [Math.floor(x0), Math.floor(y0), Math.ceil(x1), Math.ceil(y1)]; }
  var CACHE = new Map(), BYTES = 0, STATS = { made: 0, ms: 0, evicted: 0 }, QY = 1;
  function qy(y, Df) { return y >= Df ? y : Df - QY * (Df - y); }   // bld41: a ground point inside the footprint, drawn with the building's depth
  function cacheGet(k) { var e = CACHE.get(k); if (e) { CACHE.delete(k); CACHE.set(k, e); } return e; }
  function cachePut(k, e) { CACHE.set(k, e); BYTES += e.bytes; var cap = API.budgetMB * 1048576; while (BYTES > cap && CACHE.size > 1) { var k0 = CACHE.keys().next().value; if (k0 === k) break; BYTES -= CACHE.get(k0).bytes; CACHE.delete(k0); STATS.evicted++; } }
  var API = {
    version: VERSION, K: K, SUN: { x: SX, y: SY }, budgetMB: 24, skyLit: false, Q: .55,
    types: function () { return Object.keys(TYPES).map(function (k) { var T = TYPES[k]; return { id: k, he: T.he, use: T.use, W: T.W, D: T.D, floors: T.floors }; }); },
    info: function (id) { var Mo = model(id, 0); return { id: id, he: Mo.T.he, W: Mo.T.W, D: Mo.T.D, H: Mo.H, floors: Mo.T.floors }; },
    ready: function () { return LOGO_N >= Object.keys(LOGO_SVG).length; },
    make: function (id, rot, res, night) {
      rot = rot | 0; res = res || 2; night = !!night; var key = id + '|' + rot + '|' + res + '|' + (night ? 1 : 0) + '|' + (API.ready() ? 1 : 0), e = cacheGet(key); if (e) return e;   // bld40-2: the key holds ready() — a picture made before the logos loaded is made again after
      var t0 = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0), Mo = model(id, rot), X = extents(Mo), w = X[2] - X[0], h = X[3] - X[1];
      var cv = mk(Math.ceil(w * res), Math.ceil(h * res)), c = cv.getContext('2d'); c.setTransform(res, 0, 0, res, -X[0] * res, -X[1] * res); render(c, Mo, night);
      e = { cv: cv, ox: -X[0], oy: -X[1], w: w, h: h, res: res, bytes: cv.width * cv.height * 4, H: Mo.H, foot: Mo.foot };
      STATS.made++; STATS.ms += (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0) - t0; cachePut(key, e); return e;
    },
    draw: function (ctx, x, y, id, rot, res, night) { var e = API.make(id, rot, res, night); ctx.drawImage(e.cv, x - e.ox, y - e.oy, e.w, e.h); return e; },
    /* p577 (8): every sign of the given buildings (by type and rotation), day and night — the share of its pixels drawn over after it */
    signAudit: function (list) { var out = [];
      (list || []).forEach(function (q) { [false, true].forEach(function (N) { try { var Mo = model(q.type, q.rot | 0), X = extents(Mo), w = X[2] - X[0], h = X[3] - X[1], cv = mk(Math.ceil(w * 2), Math.ceil(h * 2)), c = cv.getContext('2d');
          c.setTransform(2, 0, 0, 2, -X[0] * 2, -X[1] * 2); SIGNQA.list = []; SIGNQA.on = true; render(c, Mo, N); SIGNQA.on = false;
          SIGNQA.check(c).forEach(function (s) { out.push({ id: q.id, zone: q.zone, type: q.type, rot: q.rot | 0, night: N ? 1 : 0, sign: s.t, hidden: s.f, clip: s.clip }); }); SIGNQA.list = [];
        } catch (e) { SIGNQA.on = false; out.push({ id: q.id, zone: q.zone, type: q.type, err: String(e && e.message || e) }); } }); });
      return out; },
    band: function (id, rot) { var Mo = model(id, rot | 0), d = Math.max.apply(null, Mo.ms.map(function (m) { return K * (m.h + (m.ridge || 0)) * M + 5 - m.R[1]; }));   /* bld41: the ridge and the overhang */ return [0, -d, Mo.foot[0], d]; },
    check: function (id, rot, x, y, rects) { var b = API.band(id, rot), B = [x + b[0], y + b[1], b[2], b[3]], hits = [];
      (rects || []).forEach(function (r) { if (r.x < B[0] + B[2] && r.x + r.w > B[0] && r.y < B[1] + B[3] && r.y + r.h > B[1]) hits.push(r.id || r.kind || '?'); });
      return { ok: !hits.length, band: B, hits: hits }; },
    stats: function () { return { pictures: CACHE.size, MB: +(BYTES / 1048576).toFixed(2), made: STATS.made, ms: +STATS.ms.toFixed(1), evicted: STATS.evicted, budgetMB: API.budgetMB }; },
    clear: function () { CACHE.clear(); BYTES = 0; }
  };
  (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis).BLD40 = API;
})();

/* C3LOOK (1.11 · C3 v1) — what C3 adds to the zone's look (ZONELOOK): the turning circle of the villas' street, the pools, the player's
   wall and gate, the helipad (L7–L8) — and what moves there (D‑339): the pools' water, the gardener's mower, the gate that opens for the
   player's car, the helicopter's rotor. ground(ctx, D, N) under the buildings; live(ctx, D, now, N) every frame. */
(function () {
  function disc(ctx, x, y, r, c) { ctx.fillStyle = c; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); }
  function pools(D) { return (D.pools || []).concat(D.lvPool ? [D.lvPool] : []); }
  function ground(ctx, D, N) {

      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(p[0], p[1], p[2] - p[0], p[3] - p[1]); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.5)'; ctx.fillRect(p[0] + 4, p[1] + 2, 6, 3); });

  function prism(ctx, P, z0, h, top, side) {
    var n = P.length, u0 = z0 * K6, u1 = (z0 + h) * K6, cx = 0, cy = 0, k;
    for (k = 0; k < n; k++) { cx += P[k][0] / n; cy += P[k][1] / n; }
    for (k = 0; k < n; k++) { var a = P[k], b = P[(k + 1) % n], mx = (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, my = (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, nx = b[1] - a[1], ny = a[0] - b[0];

  function rectAt(f, r, w) { var dx = f[0] - r[0], dy = f[1] - r[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, px = -dy / L * w / 2, py = dx / L * w / 2;   // מלבן מ-f עד r ברוחב w
    return [[f[0] + px, f[1] + py], [f[0] - px, f[1] - py], [r[0] - px, r[1] - py], [r[0] + px, r[1] + py]]; }
  function atLen(P, d) { var k, l, a, b;                                                              // הנקודה במרחק d לאורך המסלול; לפני ההתחלה ואחרי הסוף — בהמשך הקו
    if (d <= 0) { a = P[0]; b = P[1]; l = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) || 1; return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) / l * d, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) / l * d]; }

  function plen(P) { var s = 0; for (var k = 0; k + 1 < P.length; k++) s += Math.hypot(P[k + 1][0] - P[k][0], P[k + 1][1] - P[k][1]); return s; }

  function along(P, f) { var L = [], tot = 0; for (var k = 0; k + 1 < P.length; k++) { var l = Math.hypot(P[k + 1][0] - P[k][0], P[k + 1][1] - P[k][1]); L.push(l); tot += l; }

  function alongT(P, TT, u) { var k = 0; while (k < TT.length - 2 && u > TT[k + 1]) k++;           // במהירות של כל קטע (הבעלים 18:33): הזמן של כל נקודה מחושב מראש
